scope: C-005 product-date-v1, VIEW_CONTINUATION grants, StableSubjectId, seed-v1, named choice-v1 and immutable generation manifest selection

T-C005-CORE-001.selector: C-005 deterministic product-time, seed-v1 and GenerationManifest suites
assertions: every ADR-0002 date, weekly window, root seed, LP32 material, named choice and rejection-boundary vector is recomputed
stable subject, ProductDate, result version, namespace, candidate order and manifest inputs fail closed on invalid or ambiguous values
VIEW_CONTINUATION and GENERATION_COMPLETION close at exact left-closed/right-open boundaries without granting check-in writes
an existing manifest selection remains frozen when a newer active manifest appears

T-C005-DB-001.selector: C-005 real PostgreSQL continuation fences and immutable manifest selection
assertions: a real PostgreSQL 18 migration enforces exact grant policy, expiry, operation and immutable-column ACL constraints
account-level advisory, session-row and result-visibility fences serialize grant creation with Safety, logout, DAY deletion, consent withdrawal and result blocking
go-today CAS invalidation and database triggers make existing grants unusable without rewriting them to a new product date
active manifest selection is deterministic at the activation instant while exact historical selection keeps the original ref and fingerprint
a stored manifest whose canonical bytes disagree with its fingerprint fails closed with MANIFEST_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH
